Cancellation and refund policy

Live online purchases are currently closed.

Before paying

You can leave checkout before authorising a payment. There are no automatic renewals. If your bank shows a debit but you see no activation, contact support before retrying.

After paying

Contact us if you were charged twice, paid for access we cannot deliver, or received access materially different from the order. We will investigate, give you a complaint reference, and correct the issue or process a refund as applicable. If we cancel an order before supplying access, we will arrange a refund of the captured amount.

Once the correct plan has been supplied and activated as described, a change of mind alone does not qualify for a voluntary refund. Mandatory rights and remedies continue to apply.

Request and track a refund

Send the order or payment reference and a brief explanation to training@thecosmicenergizers.com. Approved refunds return through the original payment route where available. We will confirm the refund reference and expected timing and process approved refunds within applicable time limits.
